# blog

Static tech blog. One article = one self-contained directory under `articles/<slug>/`
(images, JS, data all live inside it). Published to GitHub Pages at
https://osjupiter.github.io/blog/ via `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` on push to main.

## Generated files — never edit by hand

- `index.html` and `sitemap.xml` are generated by `scripts/build_index.py`
  (CI regenerates them on deploy; run locally for preview).
- The generator reads each article's `<title>` and first `<p class="subtitle">`,
  and takes published/updated dates from git history.

## Article conventions

- `articles/<slug>/index.html` — English, dark hacker style (copy an existing
  article's `<style>` block as the starting point).
- `<head>` must include: `meta description`, `link canonical`
  (`https://osjupiter.github.io/blog/articles/<slug>/`), hreflang alternates
  (en / ja / x-default), OGP tags, twitter:card, JSON-LD `TechArticle`.
  Copy the head of an existing article and adjust.
- All asset references must be relative paths (`data/foo.json`, not `/data/foo.json`).

## Japanese translation (required for every article)

Each article has a pre-translated `articles/<slug>/index.ja.html`, written by
Claude when the article is added. Rules:

- Identical HTML structure to `index.html` — same tags, same `<script>`/`<style>`
  content (visualization JS must keep working). Only translate human-readable prose.
- `<html lang="ja">`; canonical / og:url / JSON-LD url point to
  `.../articles/<slug>/index.ja.html`; JSON-LD gets `"inLanguage": "ja"`;
  title / description / og tags / JSON-LD headline+description translated.
- Tone: 技術ブログのです・ます調. Keep technical terms English where Japanese
  engineers normally would (fsync, COW, blktrace, dm-era, …). Do not translate
  code blocks, commands, identifiers, or viz control/button labels.
- Language switcher right after `<div class="container">`:
  - EN page: `<div class="lang-switch"><strong>EN</strong> · <a href="index.ja.html">日本語</a></div>`
  - JA page: `<div class="lang-switch"><a href="./">EN</a> · <strong>日本語</strong></div>`
  - plus the `.lang-switch` CSS rules (copy from an existing article).
- **When the English article changes, update `index.ja.html` in the same commit.**
- `build_index.py` auto-detects `index.ja.html` and adds the 日本語 link on the
  index and the URL to the sitemap — no generator changes needed per article.
